about: How each Loopcut cloud tool appears to the agent: its MCP tool name and a short description. Input schemas come from the server's catalog. A catalog tool missing here keeps its own name and the server's description.

render.name: render_quote
render.description: Price a cloud render of a saved .blend on an RTX 4090. Packs the scene and every texture, library and cache it uses with a local headless Blender and uploads what the cloud lacks. While the result says status "preparing", call again with the same arguments. Frames default to frame 1 only. Check warnings for missing files (they render pink).

asset_search.name: asset_search
asset_search.description: Search free CC0 libraries (Poly Haven, ambientCG, Physically Based) for models, materials, HDRIs and textures, with licence, size, preview and download details. Try it before generating a model or texture.

image_to_3d.name: image_to_3d
image_to_3d.description: Make a textured 3D model (GLB) from a prompt, a local reference image, or both. For new props and concept meshes, not exact CAD. Takes 1-5 minutes.

retopology.name: remesh
retopology.description: Cloud remesh: rebuild a mesh with clean quads or triangles at a target face count, with its textures baked onto the new mesh. Export the object to a .glb first. Quads come back as FBX, triangles as GLB.

sfx.name: sound_effect
sfx.description: Make a sound effect (WAV, 0.5-30 s) from a description: impacts, ambience, foley. Not speech or music.

voice_line.name: voice_line
voice_line.description: Speak a line of text as WAV audio with a chosen voice and direction, for characters or narration.

image_generate.name: image_generate
image_generate.description: Make a PNG image from a prompt, optionally guided by a local reference image: concept art, backplates, references.

image_edit.name: image_edit
image_edit.description: Change an existing image (a local PNG, JPEG or WebP) from a text instruction, with an optional PNG mask, e.g. to restyle a render.

motion_from_video.name: motion_from_video
motion_from_video.description: Capture a person's full-body motion, hands included, from a local MP4, MOV or WebM (one person, whole body in view, mostly still camera; at most 60 s captured, chosen with start_s and end_s). 3 credits per second captured, 2-second minimum. Returns motion.bvh (SOMA 77-joint skeleton) and motion.json; motion_apply then puts it on the user's rig in a .blend.

motion_from_text.name: motion_from_text
motion_from_text.description: Make 2-10 s of humanoid body animation from a short description of one action (NVIDIA Kimodo, built with Meta Llama 3). 2 credits per second of motion. Fingers stay still; not for faces, props or finger work. Returns motion.bvh (SOMA 77-joint skeleton) and motion.json; motion_apply then puts it on the user's rig in a .blend.
